result.summary: The page layout is generally sound, but there are a couple of issues in the 'Popular right now' cards: an implausible '-100%' discount badge and an inconsistent, low-contrast favorite (heart) button on the second card.

issues.description: The promotional badge on the second 'Popular right now' card reads '-100%', implying the entire order is free. This is almost certainly a data/formatting error (e.g. a discount fraction rendered as a percentage) rather than a real offer.
issues.suggestion: Validate the discount value before rendering and cap/format it correctly (e.g. '-20%' or 'Free item'); hide the badge if the value is out of the expected range.

issues.description: The favorite (heart) button on the second card uses a dark, near-black circular background with a dark outline icon, placed over a dark image area, making it barely visible. The equivalent button on the Tokumaru Ramen card above uses a white circle with a dark icon.
issues.suggestion: Apply the same white/translucent circular background and dark icon styling to all favorite buttons, ensuring sufficient contrast against varied image backgrounds.

issues.description: The heart icon buttons have no visible text label; combined with the low-contrast variant, their tappable state (favorited vs not) is ambiguous.
issues.suggestion: Add accessible labels (e.g. 'Add to favorites') and a clearly distinct filled state for favorited items.

issues.description: The first 'Fastest near you' card (Green Bowl Poké) has a very light, nearly white image background while its sibling cards use dark imagery, making the row look visually inconsistent and the card edges hard to perceive.
issues.suggestion: Normalize card imagery treatment (e.g. add a subtle border, background tint, or consistent image overlay) so cards in the same carousel look uniform.
